title: Zesty Ukrainian Fennel Dumplings
description: A tangy, aerated dumpling dish featuring fresh fennel, lemon zest, and dill, perfect for kids and served in a traditional earthenware bowl.
instructions: In a large bowl whisk together whole wheat flour, baking powder, and salt until well mixed.
Add warm water, olive oil, and egg white to the dry mix and stir until a soft dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 2 minutes until smooth, then cover with cling film and let it rest 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl combine sliced fennel, chopped dill, minced garlic, diced onion, lemon zest, and lemon juice.
Pinch off small pieces of dough about the size of a walnut and roll them into flat discs.
Place a spoonful of the fennel mixture in the center of each disc and fold the dough over to seal, creating dumpling shapes.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and carefully drop the dumplings in batches.
Cook the dumplings for 3-4 minutes or until they rise to the surface and are cooked through.
Remove the dumplings with a slotted spoon and serve immediately in a warm earthenware bowl.
Garnish with an extra sprinkle of fresh dill and a drizzle of lemon juice if desired.
